BrochureContent.Content:
Bowe Property presents to the market a most beautiful two bedroom, detached countryside property in the wonderful lifestyle location of Nohoval, within 400m walking distance of the charming village in a near coastal location, a little over 7km from Belgooly, 13km from Carrigaline, 21km from Cork Airport and 10km from Kinsale. The property is detached, sits on an elevated private position on the approach to Nohoval village and offers itself as a wonderful home that has been carefully curated and renovated by its existing owners. Accommodation consists of two bedrooms, bathroom together with an open plan kitchen/dining/living area complimented by a separate utility room. The property features high levels of finishes incorporating good design that is simple, versatile and functions perfectly. The property is in superb condition and has had the benefit of a complete overhaul in terms of its specification, electrics, plumbing and windows. Its appointment throughout is superb with a fully fitted hand-crafted kitchen, fully fitted bathroom and has a host of features including laminate wooden flooring, ceramic tiling, oil fired central heating and much, much more. The property sits on a plot of a little over 0.34acre which offers ample space and privacy. The property has a detached outhouse that is configured and ideal for use as a home office, den or hobby room. 

For those seeking the perfect countryside near coastal lifestyle whilst remaining connected to a choice of nearby towns and villages, within walking distance of Nohoval village itself, will find this property the most interesting prospect. 

Viewing comes highly recommended and is strictly by prior appointment with the sole selling agents. 


Accommodation

Kitchen/Dining/Living - 9.13m x 3.16m 
Fully fitted with presses and cupboards. Integrated appliances include electric oven and hob. Freestanding appliances include dishwasher and fridge/freezer. Ceramic tiled floor. Recessed lighting.
Living Area
Feature solid fuel stove. Two windows to side. Wall mounted shelving, Access to utility room & side hallway. T.V. & telephone point. Radiator. 


Utility Room - 1.96m x 1.84m 
Plumbed and fitted with washing services. Fully fitted with cupboards. Window to side & rear. Door to front. Ceramic tiled floor. Radiator


Side Hall - 2.48m x 1.11m
Access to bedrooms & bathroom. Ceramic tiled floor. Recessed lighted. Attic hatch.


Bedroom 1 - 4.17m x 3.38m
Built in robe. Window to front & to rear. Laminate wooden floor. Radiator


Bedroom 2 - 3.56m x 3.39m
Built in robe. Window to side. Laminate wooden floor. Wall mounted shelving. Radiator.


Bathroom - 2.30m x 2.03m
Fully fitted with w.c., wash hand basin with vanity unit & oversized walk-in shower-one power shower & one Mira electric shower. Ceramic tiled walls & floor. Frosted window to side. Chrome heated towel radiator.


Attached Garage - 5.69m x 2.56m
Roller garage door to front. Light & power points.


Outside Office - 4.27m x 3.53m
Window to front & window to side. Laminate wooden floor. Power points & light points. Six wall mounted lights.


Services: 
Oil fired central heating, underfloor heating in bathroom
Private Services-septic tank and well
